environment.preparation: Fresh database per run: Django migrate plus the approved Drizzle bootstrap (tooling/scripts/run-union-eyes-drizzle-bootstrap.mjs), UE_AUTHORITY_COMBINED_URL pointing at an admin connection

command: UE_AUTHORITY_COMBINED_URL=<admin url of a fresh combined database> pnpm exec vitest run --project union-eyes-heavy apps/union-eyes/db/__tests__/tenant-isolation-remediation.postgres.test.ts
transport: Route handlers run unmodified. withRLSContext opens a real transaction, SET LOCAL ROLE union_eyes_runtime and sets app.current_org_id; withSystemContext assumes union_eyes_system. Bare db statements run on the admin connection, where row-level security does not apply.
cases: arbitration_precedents: runtime role in another organization sees none of the owner's rows; UPDATE and DELETE affect 0 rows
precedent route GET: private and public precedent of another organization read as 404; owner reads the full row
precedent route PATCH/DELETE by another organization: 404, nothing changed, no audit; owner PATCH persists and audits; unsupported federation sharing refused
steward directory: member projection excludes personal phone, notes, grievance link; other-organization and non-active rows 404; officer read audited; officer of another organization 404
report executor joins on the admin connection: non-equi, LEFT, RIGHT and FULL joins return no row of another organization; the same statement as the other organization returns its own row
reconciliation run lookup on the admin connection: another organization receives null
dues initiation: ten simultaneous initiations on separate connections create one pending payment; another member unaffected; another organization's runtime context sees no payment
recognition_awards and pilot_events: hidden from another organization with or without a predicate
findings: union_eyes_system holds no privilege on arbitration_precedents: the system-role read first written for shared precedents failed with permission denied; the route now reads in the tenant context
notProven: The export, settings and profile-role routes have not run natively
Webhook settlement of dues payments natively
HTTP-level behaviour of /api/version and /api/docs through the proxy
Browser, accessibility, performance and rate-limit acceptance
